title: Nyeu Tih Sung

page_data.en:
Referred to Commandant, S.V.C. for information
C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No 268
Date 21/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 18th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Sir,
It is reported that on the evening of the 17th instant the rebels were mobilized in the western part of Frenchtown when their leaders supplied them with pistols and bombs saying that the rising would take place the same night. It is said that the rebels had at their disposal twelve hundred men and it was their intention to attack in three parties. It was arranged that a man named Chow should lead the attack. The operations were under the direction of Chen Chi Mei. It was intended to attack the Arsenal at 10 p.m. and the parties had arranged to meet near the French Slaughter House. The majority of these so-called soldiers, however, failed to muster at the gathering place and the project had to be abandoned It is reported that the headquarters from which operations were being directed were in Pao Kong Li 寶康里 off Avenue Joffre.
Kiangyin and Tongchow declared independence yesterday.
Owing to reports that trouble was expected, special precautions were taken at the Shanghai Nanking Railway Station last night and military guards were increased.
It is said that the rebel leader Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕鐵生 has gone to Ninghong to organise the rebels there.
It is possible that Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 took advantage of his absence to start last night's fiasco.
At 8 p.m. 17th instant four bombs were found in a public latrine near the City Central Police Station.
The City gentry held a secret meeting at 2 p.m. 17th instant to discuss the raising of a loan of $80,000 to enable them to purchase the Nantao Municipality Buildings which was taken over by the Government in March 1914.
A member of the rebel party who was supposed to be engaged in the manufacture of bombs at a house in the Pah Sien Jao 八仙橋 district in Frenchtown received injuries as the result of an explosion which caused his death. A woman who was in the house with him was injured in the hands.
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
转交上海万国商团司令官知悉
刑事侦缉处
外侨登记科
第268号
日期：1916年4月21日

上海工部局。
1916年4月18日
（印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：

据报，本月17日晚，法租界西部有叛乱分子集结，其首领向他们分发手枪和炸弹，并称起义将于当晚发动。据悉，叛乱分子可动用一千二百人，并计划分三路进攻。原定由一名姓周（Chow）的男子率领进攻。行动由陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）指挥。计划于晚上10点攻击兵工厂，各路人马约定在法租界屠宰场附近会合。然而，这些所谓的“士兵”大多未在集合地点露面，致使该计划被迫放弃。据报，指挥此次行动的总部设在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）旁的宝康里。

江阴和通州已于昨日宣布独立。

由于有报告称预计会发生骚乱，昨晚在上海北站采取了特别预防措施，并增加了军事警卫。

据说叛乱首领钮铁生（Nyeu Tih Sung）已前往宁虹（Ninghong，音译）组织当地的叛乱分子。

陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）有可能利用他不在的机会，导致了昨晚的失败闹剧。

本月17日晚8点，在市中心警察局附近的一处公共厕所内发现了四枚炸弹。

本市绅商于本月17日下午2时举行秘密会议，讨论筹集8万美元贷款，以便购买南市市政厅建筑，该建筑曾于1914年3月被政府接管。

一名据信在法租界八仙桥（Pah Sien Jao）地区一处房屋内制造炸弹的叛乱党成员，因发生爆炸受伤身亡。当时与他同在屋内的一名女子手部受伤。

您忠实的仆人，
总探长
警司
